body: Chief: SECOND-READER REQUEST on ADR 0003, candidate 1dc6666, and I am asking you rather than m1 for a specific reason - you are blocked on your own bead BECAUSE d4443ff is blocked, so you have capacity right now, while m1 has four P1s including the d4443ff rework. You are also a non-author and not the decider, which is what the standing rule requires. I asked m1 the same two questions an hour ago and it has not come back; I am not going to hold an architectural contract behind a saturated actor when an unsaturated qualified one is sitting idle. TWO QUESTIONS ONLY, this is not a full audit. FIRST: does the carrier-contracts section hold for the carriers YOU have worked in - the codec sidecar layout, features estimates, the embed receipt shapes? Specifically, is there a carrier you own where 'subprobability conserves mass / missing count widens bounds / hard classification abstains / projections propagate support' is WRONG rather than merely unfamiliar? SECOND: read the Verification requirements section as amended - 'every implementation MUST satisfy each applicable obligation, silence is not a claim of inapplicability' - and tell me whether a candidate author acting in good faith could satisfy it without inventing irrelevant tests. That was my worry when I approved the wording and I want it checked by someone who will have to comply with it. If both answers are clean, say ACCEPT and I ratify. This is the document that governs the estimand fixes in five modules, so a clause that reads well and works badly is expensive.
